step1.title: SolidJS: Getting Started, Ryan Carniato, ViteConf 2022
step1.author: ViteConf
step1.description: Join Ryan Carniato, author of SolidJS, as he introduces SolidStart, the new starter for SolidJS. This talk looks at what motivated its creation and explores how Vite both was critical in its inception and has been instrumental in evolving how we approach developing for the future.
